values.note: 33 drive-in sites, 11 electric (all in the B loop) and 3 pull-throughs, plus 4 walk-in tent sites and a canoe-in site. Spurs 46 ft and longer on ReserveMN.

sites.source: DNR overnight facilities (Drive-in Sites '33 Sites'; Pull-Through Sites '3 Sites'; Electric Sites '11 Sites'; RV Length Limit '50 Feet'; Walk-in Sites '4 Sites'; one canoe-in site) + ReserveMN facility 896 (32 drive-in units, VehicleLength 46-157, 3 Pull-thru), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Showers are seasonal. No dump station in the park; the nearest are in Windom and Jackson.

facilities.source: DNR overnight facilities (Showers 'Operates seasonally'; Vault Toilets 'Available year-round at picnic shelter and campground') + seasonal update ('This park Does NOT have a dump station. Dump stations are available in the nearby cities of Windom (Highway 60 and 71) and Jackson (I-90 and Highway 71).'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: 2026 season on ReserveMN: May 8 to October 18.

values.note: Self-service park: every permit and registration is online, and staff cannot book on site. The canoe-in site is first-come.

booking.source: DNR alert ('Kilen Woods State Park is a self-service park. note: Campground in the wooded Des Moines River valley, a self-service park with no staffed office. The river is about 0.3 mile from the drive-in sites. --Claude
